cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Desk serves solo entrepreneurs and educators in Ghana who need an AI assistant for task management, scheduling, and note-taking — without cloud dependencies or subscription fees.

test_prompts.prompt: Create a task to follow up with the supplier about the bulk chalk order by Friday, and schedule a meeting with the volunteer coordinator next week to discuss training session logistics.
Search my notes for any previous communication with Supplier ABC, then draft a professional email to them requesting updated pricing for classroom materials.
